stem: The Cripps Mission (1942), sent by the British government to secure Indian cooperation in World War II, was ultimately rejected by the Congress mainly because:

options.option_text: It did not offer immediate full self-government/independence
It offered complete immediate independence, which Congress found unacceptable
It was proposed by Gandhi himself
It abolished the British monarchy immediately

explanation: The Cripps proposals offered Dominion Status only after the war, seen as inadequate — Gandhi called it 'a post-dated cheque on a crashing bank'.
